question: Should generic tool-progress intent become a permanent public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-payload` contract for channel plugins?
rationale: The bug can be repaired mechanically, but the PR also establishes a new public cross-plugin metadata convention whose long-term ownership and API shape require maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep the generic SDK contract
options.body: Retain the additive generic marker and predicate, fix native-block propagation, and document or test the contract as the shared producer-to-channel seam.

options.title: Keep progress intent internal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry equivalent typed metadata through an internal portable delivery contract before Slack consumes it.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Retain the additive generic marker and predicate, fix native-block propagation, and document or test the contract as the shared producer-to-channel seam.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent Slack native-block implementation and carried the Codex extension boundary involved in producing these payloads.
